text:
maria: FYI customer Hawthorn reported increased hallucinations after we merged their LoRA and switched to int4 for inference. putting quick eval pack here for triage.
aj: timeline? when did the merge + quant happen?
maria: merged yesterday @ 18:03 UTC, quant rollout to dedicated pools at ~02:00 this morning. reports started ~03:30 from their QA.
kevin: do we have the evalpack results vs baseline? small/fast checks are fine.
aj: ran tiny-evalpack (50 q/a pairs + 20 instruction tasks). summary:
```
baseline fp16: pass rate 92%, avg hallucination score 0.08
merged lora fp16: pass rate 90%, halluc score 0.11
merged lora int4: pass rate 71%, halluc score 0.28
```
aj: the delta is concentrated on named-entity questions and long context in 2-3 prompts.
maria: interesting — sounds like quant amplification rather than LoRA catastrophe. but still customer-visible.
ci-bot: CI job #7421 for hawthorn/lora-merge finished: unit-tests OK, nightly-evals: regression detected (hallucination_increase=0.20)
devon: thanks for the quick numbers. can we repro locally on a single GPU with our int4 runtime? share the command you used.
aj: repro script:
```
scripts/repro_hawthorn.sh --model redwood/hawthorn-lora:merged --quant int4 --evalpack tiny-evalpack.json
```
aj: logs attached in gist: gist.github.com/redwood/hawthorn-int4-repro
kevin: I pulled the logs — KV cache indexing looks normal. but attention kernel at step 4 shows slightly different float dynamics with int4 kernel fallback. suspect accumulator saturation on long seqs.
maria: any quick mitigations we can try server-side that don't require re-training the adapter?
devon: ideas:
- use fp16 for requests with long_context flag (detect by length)
- increase activation scaling / use per-channel quantization
- enable conservative KV cache residency so early tokens use fp16 and only rely on int4 later
aj: quick ablation I ran: int4 + per-channel-scale reduced halluc score from 0.28 -> 0.18 and improved pass rate to 80%.
kevin: good. that suggests quant config is main factor. do we have a runtime knob for per-channel scales? I can wire one into serving policy.
maria: customer wants fix ASAP. prefer a config rollout rather than reverting LoRA. what about a staged rollout: apply per-channel quant to Hawthorn's routing only and monitor.
devon: we can add a routing policy that pins hawthorn tokens to quant_profile=pc-scale-int4. set canary to 10% of requests first.
aj: also queued a small re-eval with 200 examples — will post numbers in ~30m.
ci-bot: Deploy plan: create dedicated routing rule hawthorn-quant-profile, push config to dedicated pool subset (pool-id: ded-hw-3). canary 10% 1h -> 50% 3h -> 100% 12h. rollback on halluc_score_increase > 0.05.
kevin: I'll implement the runtime flag today. patch: https://github.com/redwoodinc/inference/pull/4587 (adds quant_profile header and fallback behavior)
maria: @kevin please prioritize. @aj please attach the 200-sample eval when done and include example failure cases for customer-facing notes.
aj: posted updated eval:
```
int4 default: pass 68%, halluc 0.31
int4 pc-scale: pass 83%, halluc 0.14
fp16 merged: pass 89%, halluc 0.09
```
aj: example failure (int4 default): "Client Hawthorn's product launch is next week, we must ship by Friday" -> model hallucinates release date for product.
maria: good to have concrete examples. I'll draft customer-facing note: explain we found quant sensitivity, temporary config change to reduce hallucinations, next steps include fine-tuning with quant-aware training if needed.
devon: long-term: propose quant-aware fine-tune (QAT) for their adapter or a lightweight distillation pass. but config route seems fastest.
kevin: merged runtime flag to canary branch, rolling out now to ded-hw-3. monitoring hooks added in console: hawthorn/latency, hawthorn/halluc_score.
ci-bot: Canary deploy triggered: ded-hw-3 -> 12 GPUs. monitoring alarm set.
aj: early signals after 1h canary: halluc score dropped from 0.31 -> 0.15, latency +4ms median. no error increase.
maria: excellent. I'll ping customer and propose this mitigation while we scope QAT. assigning:
- kevin: prod config + finalize rollback criteria
- aj: extended evalpack (1k) + prepare QAT data slices
- devon: customer comm draft
maria: thanks team. keep thread updated. :thumbsup:
kevin: noted, will post PR to ops for permanent profile mapping once QA signs off.
aj: will run overnight 1k eval and post results in morning.
ci-bot: Note: thread archived in 7 days unless pinned.
